title: Henselian smooth ambient system for a formal affine space over a trait
statement: Let $C$ be a complete discrete valuation ring with separably closed residue field $k$, and let $m\geq0$. A discrete valuation ring is a Noetherian local domain of dimension one with principal maximal ideal; completeness is for powers of that ideal [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $E$ be the strict localization of $\mathbf A^m_C=\operatorname{Spec}C[x_1,\ldots,x_m]$ at the $k$-rational origin in its closed fibre [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Then $E$ is affine, Noetherian, regular, excellent and strictly henselian local with residue field $k$, and its maximal-ideal completion is $\widehat E=\operatorname{Spec}C[[x_1,\ldots,x_m]]$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-regular-scheme, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. There is a small cofiltered inverse system of affine Noetherian regular excellent strictly henselian local schemes $E_\alpha$ over $E$, with affine local transition maps, limit $\widehat E$, and local projection maps $\widehat E\to E_\alpha$; all closed residue field maps are the identity of $k$. Each $E_\alpha$ is a strict localization at a $k$-rational closed-fibre point of a smooth finite-type $E$-scheme and is also a strict localization of a scheme of finite type over $C$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Writing $E=\operatorname{Spec}A$, for every index $\alpha$ and every $n\geq1$ there is an $E$-section $\sigma:E\to E_\alpha$ whose composite with $\widehat E\to E$ agrees with $\widehat E\to E_\alpha$ on $\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m_A^n)$.

source.place: XV 3.1.3–3.1.4, printed p.222, and III §2, printed pp.35–36 (arbitrarily close sections); I 10.3 (Popescu). The strict-local stage formulation includes strict localization of the smooth models at the common residue-field point.
